The release payload is valid, the GitHub repository is live and well-maintained, and all public surfaces are reachable. Robust partner integrations with Fivetran and GitLab are confirmed, and both npm and PyPI packages are verified as published. Furthermore, the GitHub Actions CI is passing, ensuring a releasable codebase. The Vertex AI Agent Builder configuration is validated, indicating readiness for deployment. The only remaining items are owner-specific tasks: recording a demo video and providing a GCP project ID for full Vertex AI Enterprise cloud deployment, neither of which impact the core technical readiness.
